描述_ZN: The Scroll of Plum Blossoms and Stones, Modern, painted by Chen Shizeng, on paper, color on paper, 136.5 cm in length and 45.1 cm in width.　　The painting is inscribed on the right side with the following inscription: "In the middle of the garden, the cold has ended and the snow has disappeared. The general thinness is boring, and the fragrance under the window seals the far flood. The flying jade on the wall complains about the xiao, and the wind and rain come at night to wash the delicate spring. Written in the stone room of Anyang in mid-summer of Kuaihai by Chen Hengke, a teacher." Inscriptions: "Chen decay", "Shi Zeng" and "Chen Hengdali" seals.　　The year "Kuihai" is the twelfth year of the Republic of China (1923).　　The wax plum blossoms in midwinter and is named after its yellow color like wax, which is mostly born in southern China and is less common in the north. Chen Shizeng's painting shows the elegant and light quality of the plum blossoms, which is like a fragrance wafting out through the picture, refreshing the heart. The lakes and rocks are written with large, thick ink strokes, and the shapes are elegant in their simplicity.
